Score extra-time matches from the events, not the 90-minute fixture score

Source: R/epv_net_goals.R
dot-ng_fixtures_extra_time.Rd

opta_fixtures.parquet stores the 90-minute score: Dinamo Zagreb v Thun (2026-07-28) reads 2-2 there, 3-2 in the events after a period-4 goal. Net goals reconciles each team to its goal difference, so without this the value of an extra-time goal is reconciled away from the side that scored it (panna#463: 703 of the 704 matches with an extra-time goal differ).

Usage

.ng_fixtures_extra_time(fixtures, events, lineups)

Arguments

fixtures

Fixtures with match_id, home_team_id, away_team_id, home_score, away_score.

events

Opta events with match_id, period_id, type_id, team_id and qualifier_json (own goals).

lineups

Opta lineups (home/away side per match).

Value

fixtures as a data.table with the scores replaced on extra-time matches, and attributes n_extra_time (matches rescored), n_changed (scores that moved) and n_unmatched (teams did not match).

Details

Only matches with an event in period 3 or 4 are rescored, from .build_match_results_from_events() (extra time in, shootout out). A normal match keeps its fixture score, so a thin feed missing a goal event cannot move its target. The events' home/away sides are matched to the fixture's by team id; a match whose two teams do not match is left as it is and counted.
